ai_training.title: AI training tasks: starter kit
steps: Pick 2 well-known sites that pay for AI rating / writing work (search 'AI training jobs remote'); read their own pay and rules page first
Apply with your real name; take the assessment in one quiet sitting (30-90 min); write in your own words
Never pay to apply or to 'unlock' work: real sites pay you, never the other way
When work comes: 1-2 hours on weekday evenings, after the market closes; log hours and $ in the Ledger
Set aside 25-30% for taxes (you are a contractor: no tax is taken out)
rules: Do the tasks yourself: using an AI to answer AI-training tasks is banned and ends the account
One account per person, your real identity
Keep task content private (they sign you to confidentiality)
ai_training.money: About $15-30 an hour for general English tasks when work is there (ZipRecruiter average $27.67 for remote annotation); hours are never guaranteed.

user_testing.title: Paid website tests: starter kit
steps: Sign up on 2 tester sites with your real details; do the practice test well (it decides if you get tests)
Have a quiet room, a working microphone and the PC ready; tests appear in the site's feed with the pay shown first
Think out loud: say what you see, what you expect and what confuses you; that is the whole job
Take only tests whose screener honestly fits you (lying gets the account closed)
PayPal pays about 14 days after a test; log each test in the Ledger
rules: Never share the sites' or clients' private content
user_testing.money: About $10 for a 20-minute recorded test ($5 flat on some sites, $30-120 for rare live interviews); a new tester often gets only a few a week.

prop.label: ESTIMATE
rules: Buy the next account only from a payout that reached your bank: one new account per payout, and only when the payout money holds two of its price (one to buy, one kept for a re-buy).
MFFU only (owner 2026-11-20): the next accounts are the Rapid EOD 25K now, then the Rapid EOD 50K and a fresh Builder 50K from payouts.
Stop rule: at most 2 re-buys from your own pocket ($183.60); past that stop and rethink.
Prop money: you can lose only the fees, never more; a bad week inside an account is the firm's money.
notes: The table was worked out at $134.40 an account (an older plan); the MFFU Rapid EOD 50K costs $165, about $31 more a buy.
Every account copies the SAME Zlarior signal (daily correlation about 0.94): a bad week hits all of them at once, so more accounts multiply the good months AND the empty ones.
Backtest of 2026 (where LIT works); on 2021-25 (no edge) the same plan makes about $0 a month. Nothing is promised.
ATLAS's $ is the stored research estimate (a different bot), added from month 3.
